oauthConsent.noTx: Invalid or expired authorization request. Please restart the connection from your AI client.
oauthConsent.title: Authorize AI access
oauthConsent.intro: An AI client is requesting access to {{org}} on your behalf, signed in as {{email}}.
oauthConsent.disabled: The AI connector (MCP) is disabled for {{org}}. Ask your administrator to enable it before connecting.
oauthConsent.scopeFinance: View financial data (budgets, margins) you have access to
oauthConsent.scopeWrite: Create and modify projects, tasks, assignments and time entries on your behalf
oauthConsent.scopeBound: Strictly limited to what you can already access. It cannot exceed your own permissions.

signInIntro: Use your account to access the workspace.
mfaIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.
enrollIntro: Your organization requires MFA. Scan this QR with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, Bitwarden…), then enter the 6-digit code below to finish signing in.
linkInvalidIntro: This password reset link is no longer valid (already used, or older than 1 hour). Ask an administrator to send a new one.
pwUpdatedIntro: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in with it.
chooseNewPwIntro: Pick a password that meets your organization’s policy.
